text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the new year, Fenomeno entered the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"—The university's sash is passed. The gap to the leader is
two and a half minutes. The runner is a senior, running his final Hakone!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unlike last year, Fenomeno was in full holiday mode right from New Year's Day, and we watched the seasonal ekiden broadcast together.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Oh, everyone is working so hard...!
choice_data_list: You really love ekiden relays, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's always packed with highlights, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Coordinating to maintain pace without getting in the runners' way—
as expected of the Traffic Police Unit.
choice_data_list: I see, so you're a fan of police motorcycles...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Protecting a single road, they are champions of justice!
As expected of a hero—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "...I wished to be an ally of justice, just like them and my father."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
When someone strays from the path, point it out
and guide them so they can follow the rules.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "It is because we have such guiding role models that people can advance toward a better future."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However... in the Classic year,
it was Golshi-san who brightened my future.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Even a bundle of lawlessness can create and protect someone's future. It can become that very possibility.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Boss. How should I... conduct myself from now on?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As someone who protects the children's future and
fosters their growth...
what is it that I can do?
choice_data_list: ...I see, so that's our next challenge.
...I see, so that's our next challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the TV, police vehicles clearing the road
and runners passing their sashes are being broadcast."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What if... you came to realize that it's not just
the police officers around you guiding the runners—
choice_data_list: Let's take a step back and think it over.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I see...! An "Umamusume Museum", is it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 'Uma Musume Museum' is a facility
attached to the Tokyo Racecourse
where you can learn about racing history.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Modern racing has evolved through people's relentless efforts to create better and better environments!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If we uncover her past to see what was needed for her growth, it'll give me a hint on who I should be!
—Understood, Boss!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decided to look around
a few exhibits with Fenomeno.
choice_data_list: The Importance of Rest in Umamusume Illness and Injury

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see. Swelling symptoms require close attention...
We should check for inflammation and make sure you get some rest...
choice_data_list: Meno, tell me right away if you're not feeling well too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Understood!
Mmh... mmmgh...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Every single exhibit here is important!
I shall take notes in my notebook!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after touring several exhibits...
Fenomeno came to a stop in front of a chronological timeline.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...They say every Umamusume bears a resemblance
to one of the Three Goddesses.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, which Goddess do I resemble most?
Is it perhaps Lady Byerley Turk, who upholds strict traditions?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
This free-spirited...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Hrmmm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after touring several exhibits...
Fenomeno came to a stop in front of a chronological timeline.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if they step away from racing,
Umamusume keep running toward their own futures."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...It is difficult to imagine.
If I were not running, I fear the children would only be frightened of me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However...
Even if the time comes when I must give up running, I still want to be someone who can protect others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after touring several exhibits...
Fenomeno came to a stop in front of a chronological timeline.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The "History of Racing"...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Japanese racing learned standards from abroad,
and evolved in its own unique way—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"History tells of origins.
At the same time, it reflects what has changed,
and what has been brought into the world."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Look at this, Boss!
Did you know that the Yasuda Kinen
is actually an older race than the Arima Kinen!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: And what's more, the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes was apparently established even earlier than those two!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
Through countless encounters and circumstances,
it has grown into the rich racing program we have today..."
choice_data_list: What was the oldest race that became its foundation?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Right! The older major Japanese races are
the Japanese Derby and—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —The Spring and Autumn "Tenno Sho."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
While both Tenno Sho races used to be 3,200 meters long,
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) was later shortened to 2,000 meters.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And the Tenno Sho (Spring), which determines
Japan's top stayer, keeps its long distance
and boasts a rich history and tradition...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—This is it.
This race is...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A place that has watched over the contests
of countless Umamusume since ancient times.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —The place that bore witness to the encounter with my fated rival.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And maybe those girls will too.
Meet someone just like I did. Grow just like I did—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Please let me run in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I will re-examine my justice from scratch once more.
Starting from the Tenno Sho (Spring), I want to find it and nurture it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—I also feel like this meeting today
was destined to be.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to disturb Fenomeno as she continued
to look at the exhibits, I decided to leave the museum
a little ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It really feels like destiny.
The Nikkei Sho she's scheduled to run in next
is the prep race for the Tenno Sho (Spring) she talked about."

—A 3200-meter long-distance race.
An excellent choice.
That's a big help. That child is someone who will bring an important future for us, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking ahead, there stood a horse girl with eyes like the melting twilight.

An unbelievable future comes only to those who believe in it!
I'm counting on you! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Without answering the question,
she vanished like the wind."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—What kind of future
would be beyond belief, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Winning every single GI entered? Or breaking the record for most GI wins and being chosen as Horse of the Year?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is it to capture the tyrant
who crossed the world stage
and is now trying to slip beyond everyone's reach?
choice_data_list: Or perhaps, all of the above...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Perhaps this is a future that could await her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that mismatched duo
continues to grow together from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Her future might grow into something filled with boundless potential."
